name: SWE-CI
description: SWE-CI is a repository-level benchmark built upon the Continuous Integration loop to evaluate code generation agents on long-term maintainability rather than short-term functional correctness. It comprises 100 tasks representing real-world code evolution histories with multiple rounds of analysis and coding iterations, assessing agents' ability to sustain code quality over time.
reputation: A new repository-level code benchmark that is not yet widely adopted, but is relevant to agentic software engineering and maintainability research.
notes: Focuses on long-term code maintainability through continuous integration rather than static one-shot fixes.
